summary:
What we developed: HELIX Crew Health is an intelligent, offline-capable health monitoring and self-evaluation software platform designed specifically for long-duration spaceflight.
​How it addresses the challenge: It integrates wearable biometric telemetry with daily physiological and psychological self-assessments into a unified dashboard. Built-in onboard analytics track trends in vital biomarkers, sleep quality, and cognitive stress to detect early indicators of space radiation effects, bone loss, immune changes, and behavioral fatigue, offering astronauts instant, actionable countermeasures.
​Why it is important: Deep-space communication delays with Earth make crew autonomy essential. By empowering astronauts to proactively spot, evaluate, and manage their own health changes in real time, HELIX Crew Health minimizes medical risks, reduces reliance on mission control, and safeguards crew well-being on extended missions.
details: What It Does & How It Works: HELIX Crew Health is a lightweight, offline-first health monitoring and self-evaluation web application designed for long-duration spaceflight. It reads astronaut biometric telemetry (heart rate variability, blood oxygen, sleep, temperature) and daily self-assessment logs (mood, fatigue, focus) stored in structured JSON datasets. Client-side logic compares these values against each astronaut’s personal baseline to detect early signs of microgravity deconditioning, radiation exposure, immune shifts, and behavioral stress—displaying instant, tailored countermeasures in a clean HTML interface. ​Key Benefits: Runs 100% locally in any browser with zero server or internet dependency, eliminates deep-space communication delays, spots subtle multi-day health drift early, and translates complex data into a clear daily readiness score. ​Intended Impact: Empowers astronauts on Artemis and Mars missions to track and manage their own health autonomously without real-time Earth support, while providing an ultra-portable health tracking model for remote, low-connectivity environments on Earth. ​Tools & Tech Stack: Built with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript for a fast, zero-dependency user interface, and JSON for lightweight local data storage, telemetry schemas, and health threshold profiles. ​Creativity: Cross-correlates physical biometrics with behavioral check-ins to catch isolation fatigue early, and includes an interactive "what-if" simulator showing how daily habits impact 7-day recovery scores. ​Key Factors Considered: Ultra-low computational overhead for spacecraft hardware, zero-cloud offline reliability, preventing alert fatigue, protecting astronaut privacy with local JSON storage, and a high-contrast layout suited for microgravity use.
